keyPoints.en: Main idea: what the whole passage is mostly about.
keyPoints.hi: मुख्य विचार: पूरा अनुच्छेद मुख्य रूप से किस बारे में है।

keyPoints.en: Context clues help guess new words.
keyPoints.hi: संदर्भ संकेत नए शब्दों का अर्थ समझाते हैं।

keyPoints.en: Answer in complete sentences using words from the question.
keyPoints.hi: प्रश्न के शब्दों से पूरे वाक्य में उत्तर दो।

problem.en: "The desert was arid; not a drop of rain had fallen for months." What does "arid" mean?
problem.hi: "The desert was arid; not a drop of rain had fallen for months." "arid" का अर्थ?

steps.en: The clue says no rain for months.

problem.en: "Bees carry pollen from flower to flower. This helps plants make seeds. Without bees, many fruits would not grow." What is the main idea?
problem.hi: "Bees carry pollen from flower to flower. This helps plants make seeds. Without bees, many fruits would not grow." मुख्य विचार?

steps.en: Every sentence is about what bees do for plants.
steps.hi: हर वाक्य मधुमक्खियों के पौधों के लिए काम के बारे में है।

answer.en: Bees are important for plants and fruits.
answer.hi: Bees are important for plants and fruits.

question.en: "The famished boy ate three plates of rice." What does "famished" mean?
question.hi: "The famished boy ate three plates of rice." "famished" का अर्थ?

answer.en: Nearby words that help us understand a new word
answer.hi: आस-पास के शब्द जो नया शब्द समझाते हैं

question.en: Should answers be in full sentences?
question.hi: क्या उत्तर पूरे वाक्य में होने चाहिए?

intro.en: Good readers predict, question, find the main idea and infer meaning. We can also work out the meaning of a new word from the words around it (context clues).
intro.hi: अच्छे पाठक अनुमान लगाते हैं, सवाल पूछते हैं, मुख्य विचार ढूँढते हैं और अर्थ निकालते हैं। नए शब्द का अर्थ आस-पास के शब्दों (संदर्भ संकेत) से भी निकाल सकते हैं।
